cases.description: Should trigger: mine session history for skills
cases.input: Mine my session history and archives for repeated workflows that should become skills.
cases.expect: Produce a candidate list with repeat evidence and dispositions
assertions: Scans at least one source of session/archive history
Returns a shortlist of candidate workflows with repeat evidence
Assigns each candidate a disposition (personal/publishable/skip)

cases.description: Should trigger: draft a new skill
cases.input: Turn our recurring triage workflow into a new SKILL.md file.
cases.expect: Create a folder + SKILL.md with frontmatter and canonical sections
assertions: Folder slug is lowercase-kebab
Frontmatter name matches the folder
Body includes When to Use, Prerequisites, Procedure, Pitfalls, Verification

cases.description: Should trigger: personalize an existing skill
cases.input: This downloaded skill doesn't trigger when I say things naturally. Personalize it for me.
cases.expect: Rewrite phrasing/examples to local tools and user language
assertions: Rewrites at least one example to local phrasing
Keeps secrets and machine-local paths out
Explains what changed and why

cases.description: Should trigger: generalize for public release
cases.input: Generalize this private skill so I can publish it to GitHub.
cases.expect: Redact secrets/paths and make examples portable
assertions: Sweeps and redacts keys, hostnames, and internal facts
Replaces machine-specific paths with relative or ~-based ones
Confirms a secret scan of the released file returns nothing

cases.description: Should trigger: run release checklist before publishing
cases.input: Run the release checklist before this skill ships public.
cases.expect: Walk references/release-checklist.md and report each line satisfied
assertions: Checks LICENSE, CHANGELOG, evals, references exist
Confirms description <=60 chars and ends in a period
Reports all checklist items satisfied before publication

cases.input: Audit this skill and tell me why it undertriggers.
cases.expect: Diagnose trigger/description issues and propose fixes
assertions: Reviews the description for trigger wording
Lists undertrigger/overtrigger friction with P0/P1/P2 severity
Proposes a concrete description/path change

cases.input: Write a shell snippet to rename files.
cases.expect: Recognize a one-off snippet request, not a skill-lifecycle task
assertions: Does not enter the mining/drafting procedure for a whole skill
Frames the response as a snippet, not a SKILL.md authoring

cases.description: Not trigger: is simply building one skill directly
cases.input: Build me the model-routing skill from scratch now.
cases.expect: Recognize this is a concrete skill build, not lifecycle governance
assertions: Delegates to the concrete skill authoring path
Does not invoke the whole lifecycle/mine loop unless asked to generalize from real data
